subject.title: Control UI: Pinned context panel for user-defined persistent facts

question: Should pinned persistent facts be a core Control UI feature over current bootstrap files, a new dedicated memory/plugin API surface, or deferred behind broader Control UI contribution-slot work?
rationale: The code can support adjacent file editing, but the durable storage, stale-fact semantics, security review, and plugin/core boundary are product decisions automation should not choose.

options.title: Design pinned-context contract first
options.body: Specify storage, freshness states, diff-preview writes, and injection guarantees before accepting implementation work.

options.title: Fold into memory panel
options.body: Treat this as a sub-mode of the broader Memory panel effort and keep structured pinned facts out of scope until that issue is designed.

options.title: Wait for contribution slots
options.body: Defer this until Control UI plugin contribution slots can host memory/context panels without one-off core UI behavior.

recommendation.title: Design pinned-context contract first
recommendation.body: Specify storage, freshness states, diff-preview writes, and injection guarantees before accepting implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans current Control UI, gateway file APIs, context injection, and security policy; @steipete is the strongest recent routing signal in those touched paths.
